ui.beyondsolo.guild.gives.title: WHAT A GUILD GIVES
ui.beyondsolo.guild.gives.0: Hunters under one name and banner, with officers to help you lead.
ui.beyondsolo.guild.gives.1: Hired NPC hunters: they fight beside your raids in their class's role and grow with every clear.
ui.beyondsolo.guild.gives.2: Raid permits: open a raid gate of your choosing, with lieutenants, a barrier and a boss made for many.
ui.beyondsolo.guild.gives.3: Every gate a member clears grows the guild; its levels raise the member cap and the gold and XP bonuses.
ui.beyondsolo.guild.gives.4: A guild chat (/gc) that reaches every member, wherever they are.

ui.beyondsolo.raid.role.vanguard.desc: Bosses turn on the vanguard first and mind its blows far more than anyone's; it takes less damage in the raid.
ui.beyondsolo.raid.role.striker.desc: Every blow a striker lands on the raid's creatures deals extra damage.
ui.beyondsolo.raid.role.support.desc: Every ten seconds a pulse heals the raiders and hunters around a support.

command.beyondsolo.solo.help.guild.creat: Founds a guild for a player (the System pays the cost).
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.guild.level: Sets the level of the players' guilds.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.guild.gold: Sets the gold in the players' guild treasuries.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.guild.hunte: Hires a hunter of a rank (and class) into the players' guilds, for free.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.guild.heal: Heals the injured hunters of the players' guilds.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.raid.open: Opens a raid gate of a rank in front of you.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.raid.make: Turns the nearest open gate into a raid gate.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.raid.start: Sends a player's raid in at once, without the countdown.
command.beyondsolo.solo.help.raid.phase: Forces the raid boss's barrier or cataclysm.
